semiconductor_relevance: High — MSTECH specializes in equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in PCB depaneling and laser cutting systems.
summary: MSTECH Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of equipment for next-generation semiconductor and PCB processes, focusing on PCB depaneling routers and automation solutions. The company offers advanced memory module routers and laser cutting systems designed to enhance productivity and process stability in semiconductor production.
capabilities: Laser cutting systems for wafer processing
In-line laser machines for wafer cutting

regional_presence.South Korea: MSTECH holds over 70% share of the domestic PCB router market and operates two production facilities there.
